title: Structured native results are authoritative; compatibility text is an adapter
summary: v0.2 introduces NativeDatabaseColumn, NativeDatabaseRow, NativeDatabaseResult and NativeDatabaseExecution. Provider-native metadata survives projection: PostgreSQL field names, OIDs, text/binary format, SQLSTATE/native status and SQL NULL can be preserved without first flattening everything to text. Existing Database Core tabular framing remains a compatibility renderer over the structured result.
invariants: SQL NULL is preserved as .nil rather than inherently becoming an empty string.
Provider-native type and field-format metadata may cross the provider-neutral boundary as evidence.
Command tags and affected-row evidence remain part of structured execution results.
COPY is not treated as an ordinary materialized result until explicit streaming ownership exists.
Compatibility text framing is downstream of the native result model, not the native result model itself.

provenance.claim: v0.2 introduces structured native result objects, preserves NULL/type/format metadata, and treats Database Core framing as an adapter.
Executed v0.2 acceptance preserves PostgreSQL OID/format, SQL NULL, command evidence, SQLSTATE, and fails closed on COPY.
